title: Tips ledger (November–February)
html:
A household tips (drikkepenge) ledger page from the notebooks — not a recipe.

Transcription note

This page records tip income between November and February. Amounts and dates are in the original handwriting on the scan; a full line-by-line transcription will be added when the ledger is checked against the scan.
